title: The AI Agent Revolution Is Here: From GPU Speed-Ups to Multi-Hour Online Work
angle: This piece will analyze how recent breakthroughs in GPU optimization, online task automation, and multi-hour task benchmarks signal a new era of highly capable and autonomous AI agents, moving beyond simple task completion to complex, sustained work.
